name: Rolling Calf
description: The Rolling Calf is one of the most feared duppies (spirits) in Jamaican folklore — a shape-shifting supernatural entity that most often appears as a large calf or bull with blazing red eyes, fire from its nostrils, and a dragging iron chain, haunting lonely roads and crossroads at night.
origin: Primarily a Jamaican tradition, with parallel duppy beliefs across the broader Caribbean.
